notes: Added missing stories to complete schema/contract, UI integration, and testing coverage.

EVAL-F5-S150.title: Define Explainability Schema Contract
EVAL-F5-S150.description: Create a standardized schema for explainability objects including fields for source, meaning, limitations, and optional confidence or provenance metadata to ensure consistent structure across provider and clinical trial signals.

EVAL-F5-S151.title: Frontend Rendering of Explainability Content
EVAL-F5-S151.description: Update chat UI message rendering to display explainability metadata in a user-friendly format, including clear labeling of source, plain-language meaning, and limitations within MessageBubble components.

EVAL-F5-S152.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Explainability Layer
EVAL-F5-S152.description: Implement tests validating that explainability objects are correctly generated, attached to evaluation signals, and propagated through EvaluateCareFacade to API responses without breaking existing contracts.
